content.text:
I've saved `spec.vl.json` and it renders with status OK; the final render shows every phase, event marker and label in place.

**Main pattern:** once each release is lined up on its own release date, the interim releases all share one short life cycle: about 6 months of development, then 18 months of support up to 12.10 and 9 months from 13.04 on. LTS releases follow a much longer cycle, and every one from 14.04 on has the same 5 + 5 + 5 years of standard support, ESM and legacy support. The early LTS releases (6.06–10.04) are the exception: they had about 3 years of desktop support plus extended server support to 5 years. 12.04 had 5 years of standard support plus 2 years of ESM.

The render printed 5 identical Vega-Lite warnings, "Detected faceted independent scales that union domain…". They come from giving the two groups separate y scales. They warn that view sizes might be off, but the render shows both panels at the correct size, so they don't change the figure.

```
REPORT
deliverable: spec.vl.json
requirements:
  R1: done - one row per release, y labels = version, sorted by release date within each group
  R2: done - x = years relative to each release's own release date (0 = release), unit in axis title
  R3: done - development / standard / extended server / ESM / legacy bars, 5 colours, legend; missing phases not drawn
  R4: done - created = filled dot, release = black tick at 0
  R5: done - row facet "LTS releases" vs "Interim releases"; LTS label also in the version text
  R6: done - title plus a one-sentence caption (subtitle) stating the main pattern
assumptions:
  - ESM starts at max(eol, eol-server); extended server support is drawn only if eol-server > eol
  - Missing/empty trailing fields are treated as "no date"
  - A year is 365.25 days; x-axis is fixed to -1..16 years to fit the longest cycle
  - Grouped LTS and interim into two panels, each ordered by release date, not one combined order
limitations:
  - Caption text is written by hand, so it will not update if the data change
  - "Today" diamond uses the render-time clock (now()); dates after today are planned
  - Vega-Lite prints 5 warnings about faceted independent y scales; they do not change the figure
```
